digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate and runaway guard
propositions: The runaway guard layer counts memo-cached repeats as loop evidence despite the memo layer serving them for free, causing the guard to trip RunawayToolLoopError on legitimate re-reads of cached evidence files.

The guard is composed outermost before the memo layer, so it observes and penalizes every call signature before memoization can eliminate the repeat, creating architectural conflict between the two shipped mitigations.

A shared ToolCallLedger with two-arm detection (distinct-ratio over executed work only, plus a served-streak backstop) decouples guard observation from memo-served calls, allowing repeats to be cached without loop penalty.

The guard records execution at exactly five sites (non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-signature miss, unparseable path, first-read whole-file fetch, truncated-window fallback) so only paths reaching actual tool invocation count as loop evidence.
